description: The named Zenodo release provides radio-frequency spectrum measurements at 428 MHz as a CSV dataset inside a ZIP archive. The describing article places it in a Hungarian national monitoring programme and explains the time-by-frequency matrix of measured field strength and the signal-anomaly annotation method. Zenodo lists the deposit as open under CC BY 4.0, with an archive of about 7.8 GB. The exact station locations, collection dates and radio-service users of this 428 MHz slice were not established on the landing page. The observations could calibrate spectrum-occupancy or interference scenarios for wireless communication infrastructure. They do not describe network links, subscribed users or outage consequences, so those parts of a service simulation need separate inputs. The measurement grid and anomaly labels should be inspected before use; this archive was not downloaded or numerically checked. The FM and DVB-T deposits from the same paper cover different bands. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: RF Spectrum Measurements at 428 MHz (CSV Dataset)
